mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, indicates a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when GDPC1 YoY growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, signaled by a negative MoM change in the industrial production index, indicates supply constraints that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time when INDPRO MoM growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp increase over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and potential recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 50% of the time when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a potential recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time when DGS10 < DGS2.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% YoY decline in the housing starts index, signals a weakening housing market and consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 50% of the time when HOUST declines > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate, defined as a 1pp increase over the past 3 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation, signaled by a 0.5pp increase in the core CPI index over the past 3 months, indicates building price pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment, signaled by a 200k increase in nonfarm payrolls over the past month, indicates a strengthening labor market and consumer spending that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when PAYEMS rises > 200k in 1 month.
